moreText: Interested in booking Momentos Alegres Photobooth for your event? Reach out below to check availability.

packages.name: Digital Photobooth Only
packages.description: Capture unlimited photos and instantly share them by text, email, or QR code. Includes custom photo template, setup, and breakdown.

packages.name: Print and Digital
packages.description: Everything included in the Digital Booth package, plus unlimited on-site photo prints for your guests to take home and enjoy.

packages.name: Video Guestbook
packages.description: Add-On. Memories to keep. Get all the heartfelt videos recorded by your guest to remember your special day. Perfect for all occasions.

packages.name: Props
packages.description: A photobooth just isn’t complete without the perfect prop! Included for free for any event over 2 hours.

packages.name: Custom Welcome Screen
packages.description: Included for free for any event 3+ hours.

packages.name: USB Keepsake Flash Drive
packages.description: Aside from the digital gallery, take home all of your event photos and videos on a USB flash drive for easy sharing and long-term storage.
